faq.q: Are exchange rates updated in real time?
faq.a: Exchange rates are refreshed each time the app opens if an internet connection is available. An internet connection is required to get the latest rates.

faq.q: Does the app work without internet?
faq.a: Yes, every conversion except currencies works offline. Currency conversions use the last cached rate.

faq.q: How do I change the app's language?
faq.a: The language can be changed directly in the app's settings. More than 16 languages are available.

support.privacy_summary: Convert Everything collects no personal data. No information is sent to third-party servers.

blocks.p: Convert Everything does not collect, store or transmit any personal data. The app runs entirely locally on your device.
The app only accesses the following resources:

ul: Internet — only to fetch exchange rates from a public API. No personal data is sent.

blocks.p: Exchange rates are provided by fawazahmed0/exchange-api, a free public API. No user data is transmitted during this request.
Convert Everything contains no advertising, no trackers and no behavioural analytics SDK.
